claims.text: No significant associations were observed between sodium intake and cardiovascular disease mortality across cardiovascular health strata after adjustment for confounders.
In participants with moderate cardiovascular health, sodium intake was inversely associated with all-cause mortality for the third quartile compared to the first quartile (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.39–0.98).

In participants with moderate cardiovascular health, sodium intake was inversely associated with all-cause mortality for the fourth quartile compared to the first quartile (HR 0.39, 95% CI 0.18–0.85).
In participants with good cardiovascular health, associations between sodium intake and all-cause mortality were similar to those in moderate cardiovascular health but nonsignificant.
Higher sodium intake compared with lowest sodium intake was generally associated with higher estimated life expectancy among participants with moderate and good cardiovascular health.
The pattern of higher sodium intake associating with higher estimated life expectancy was not observed among participants with poor cardiovascular health.

evidence.description: After adjustment for confounders, no significant associations between sodium intake and CVD mortality were observed across CVH strata during a median follow-up of 8.9 years with 198 CVD deaths.
In moderate CVH participants, third quartile [Q3] vs first quartile [Q1]: hazard ratio [HR] 0.62, 95% confidence intervals [CI] 0.39–0.98.
In moderate CVH participants, fourth quartile [Q4] vs Q1: HR 0.39, 95% CI 0.18–0.85.
Similar but nonsignificant associations were seen in good CVH participants regarding all-cause mortality.
Compared with lowest sodium intake, higher sodium intake was generally associated with higher estimated life expectancy among participants with moderate and good CVH using the life table method.
Life expectancy association pattern seen in moderate and good CVH participants was not observed among those with poor CVH.

methodologies.name: Weighted Cox proportional hazards regression and life table method
methodologies.description: Retrospective cohort study using 24-h recall sodium intake and Life's Essential 8 cardiovascular health scores linked to mortality follow-up to evaluate survival and life expectancy.
datasets: NHANES 2007–2014 linked to National Center for Health Statistics mortality follow-up through December 31, 2019
conditions: Stratified by cardiovascular health (CVH) levels assessed by Life's Essential 8 score

future_work.text: Further prospective studies are needed to determine whether cardiovascular health modifies associations between sodium intake, mortality, and life expectancy.
